description: This file defines a Perl controller class for managing FAQ entries in an admin interface, including actions for listing, creating, editing, and updating FAQs.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Admin::FAQ
classes.description: Controller class for admin FAQ management, handling CRUD operations and routing for FAQ entries.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles GET/HEAD requests to list all FAQs, preparing data for display.

methods.name: new_faq
methods.description: Displays form for creating a new FAQ.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Captures FAQ ID and loads the corresponding FAQ object, or detaches with an error if not found.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Displays form for editing an existing FAQ.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles POST request to update an existing FAQ.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST request to create a new FAQ.

methods.name: update_or_create
methods.description: Private method to save FAQ data, either updating or inserting.
